implementation: RSA CRT SP on ID-One Cosmo V8.2
description: ID-One Cosmo V8.2 is a dual interface (ISO 7816 & ISO 14443) smartcard chip compliant with Javacard 3.0.4 and GlobalPlatform 2.2.1 that supports RSA CRT encrypt/decrypt, digital signature generation/verification and keypairs generation with keys from 64 to 4096-bit by step of 32-bit.
